_comment: No Stop hook. The previous one grepped state/active.md inside the plugin's own install directory for a 'current_phase:' line and blocked session exit if it found one. It could not work: it emitted {"ok": ...} where Claude Code reads {"decision": "approve|block"}, so it never actually blocked; the state file it read is hand-maintained and was stale; and one file inside one plugin install cannot represent instances belonging to other sessions or other Lambda accounts. See docs/STOP_HOOK.md before adding another.
